items.headline: Albemarle Upgrade: Can Energy Storage Recharge Lithium's Leader?
items.snippet: Mizuho lifted 2027 adj. EBITDA estimate to $3.2B from $2.4B. 16 of 26 analysts rate Buy/Strong Buy, 8 Hold. Q3 results due Nov 4.

items.headline: Lithium's $100 Billion Supply Gap Hands Albemarle a Domestic Moat
items.snippet: Q2 Energy Storage volumes rose 11%, realized price jumped 61% to $19.53/kg; segment adj. EBITDA +229% to $723M. Silver Peak is the only active US lithium mine; seeking permits to restart Kings Mountain.

items.headline: Xos Inc. - EV Makers Split Into Winners and Laggards
items.snippet: Oct 12: Guangzhou lithium carbonate futures fell 11.8% to 104,740 yuan/t, ~10-month low; ALB -4.2% pre-market. Mizuho upgraded to Outperform, PT $130.

items.headline: Albemarle Corporation(ALB) Zacks Company Report
items.snippet: Zacks Underperform view: weaker Energy Storage volumes, falling lithium prices, supply-chain costs, weak cash conversion.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus keeps Buy; lithium up ~67% y/y but below highs; supply/demand to improve into 2027.
